source_evidence: Added one source-owned TU-private object-start binding for existing 0.01 constant at 0x66EB38. Current unique ordinary static COFF definition has exactly the same eight-byte operand payload as the pin. Original create_table FMUL and DIR32 position identify this correspondence.

Only an annotation was added; no expression, original span or historical byte token changed. Native definition and relocation pass. The other seven constants stay unbound; allocation extent, original nominal variable name and linked selection are not inferred.
